purpose: Define stable route identity fields for Alpha mission generation, Supabase validation, Core import, and support diagnostics.

candidate_id.purpose: Pool-membership identity. Mission output route.items[].candidate_id must exactly match a candidate_id present in the supplied candidate_pool.candidates or approved pool entries.
candidate_id.duplicate_scope: unique within one mission; should not repeat across the 10-mission batch unless explicitly allowed by a future batch policy

route_candidate_key.purpose: Canonical playable route identity independent of display text.
route_candidate_key.validator_use: preferred duplicate and batch-repeat key when present
route_candidate_key.duplicate_scope: unique within one mission and across one generated 10-mission batch

route_batch_dedupe_key.purpose: Graph dedupe identity, normally copied from dedupe_group, for suppressing alternate candidate rows that resolve to the same playable object.
route_batch_dedupe_key.validator_use: preferred cross-mission batch exclusion key when present
route_batch_dedupe_key.duplicate_scope: unique within one mission and across one generated 10-mission batch

app_route_item_id.purpose: App-safe deterministic route item ID that Mission Generation should copy to route.items[].item_id.
app_route_item_id.validator_use: app import item_id uniqueness and stable client storage
app_route_item_id.duplicate_scope: unique within one mission and across one generated 10-mission batch

canonical_entity_id.purpose: Canonical graph object ID. This is not enough by itself when object_type is omitted.
canonical_entity_id.duplicate_scope: same route object should not repeat across batch

dedupe_group.validator_use: fallback duplicate key when route_batch_dedupe_key is missing
dedupe_group.duplicate_scope: unique within one generated page, mission, and Alpha candidate pool export

route_display_identity_key.purpose: Normalized artist/title/type fallback for diagnosing display-level duplicates.
route_display_identity_key.validator_use: fallback only; do not use as primary identity when route_candidate_key exists
route_display_identity_key.duplicate_scope: unique within one mission and one generated 10-mission batch unless intentionally version-tested in a future contract

display_identity_fields.display_name: Preferred app-facing title for the route object.
display_identity_fields.display_label: Same preferred display title for graph/survey compatibility.
display_identity_fields.credited_artist: Preferred app-facing artist credit for track and album route candidates.
display_identity_fields.music_object_ref.display_name: Atlas/reference display title; should match display_name for canonical graph route candidates.
display_identity_fields.music_object_ref.credited_artist_name: Reference artist credit for song_recording route candidates.
display_identity_fields.internal_slug_policy: candidate_id, canonical_entity_id, route_candidate_key, route_batch_dedupe_key, dedupe_group, and source_membership_id are internal IDs and must not be preferred UI labels.

mission_output_copy_rules: route.items[].route_candidate_key should copy route_candidate_key exactly when the mission schema allows it.
route.items[].route_batch_dedupe_key should copy route_batch_dedupe_key exactly when the mission schema allows it.
route.items[].music_kit_search_hint should derive from music_kit_search_hint or preserve its artist/title components.

single_mission_blockers: route.items[].candidate_id not found in supplied candidate pool
route item display identity duplicate when stronger keys are missing
batch_blockers: same app_route_item_id repeated across the 10-mission batch
same candidate_id repeated across the 10-mission batch
same route_candidate_key repeated across the 10-mission batch
same route_batch_dedupe_key repeated across the 10-mission batch
same route_display_identity_key repeated across the 10-mission batch when stronger keys differ or are missing
non_blocking_review_metadata: risk_class == high for risky_probe or trap candidates

allowed_use: possible Atlas update provenance after user listening evidence exists
